title: WARPED
description: Add everything related to the war of the past, present and future! It's time to raise the flag of war! Prepare your troops, we are advancing.
body:
![warped](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/74a2ff6c60832a0e9ce2fcb6bbb24aa657d79939_0.webp) The "Warped" mod for Minecraft adds new elements of war and strategy. This mod was created specifically for themed battles. It includes flags, cases, banners, and a special block that transports players to a separate world similar to the standard Minecraft world. The whole mod revolves around this world, as it allows you to freely fight with your friends without the risk of damaging the original world, which is not meant for destruction. The mod adds a variety of Gamerules to help manage it, such as removing weapons and items from other mods if you don’t need them. _(There is also a command that lets you connect the magic mod "MyPED" to this mod. To do this, download MyPED version 2.5 or higher and enter `mypedConnectionToWarped true`—and have fun!)_

Screenshot's from mod:

![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc364a60d5814298e705e656bb2f97d07d54cd51_0.webp) ![wall banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f977cfced4a556b3d494295b7d834e12aeeff76b_0.webp) ![flag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc1ceb320bf1fc2335b48ea232ca41fbd378920f_0.webp) ![case](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da2239fa323329380bfb73684b414e9dea132e94_0.webp) ![Flag visible](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/879f90eef8b1756c57be324e43ebbc5f9ca6f286_0.webp)

Features:

Case — a decorative element without any functions, which may become part of future updates.

![case](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67a4aae6f002e8eff1e0cad8ca2abe29dbed13a1.png)

Flags — plans to add a flag system to trigger various events.

![flags](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9bc806bcf945bb4a3e451c3fb2c8977d50b7d530_0.webp) Future updates — the mod will expand with new blocks and mechanics related to war and strategy. "Warped" is the beginning of creating military structures and mechanics, with potential for exciting future updates.
